issues.title: The Sketch That Was Never Inked
issues.logline: A client commissions a cover they remember approving. The studio's ledger says it was only ever sketched. The Artist has to prove a negative with paper.

issues.title: Two Versions of Page Nine
issues.logline: Both pages are real, both are dated, and only one of them was drawn first. The reader is shown both; the characters are not.

issues.title: The Studio That Forgot Its Own Hand
issues.logline: An assistant's style becomes indistinguishable from the Artist's. Provenance, not style, is the only thing left that can tell them apart.
